Daily Devotional

October 1

9 For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ, 10 Who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him. (1 Thessalonians 5:9-10 KJV)

The people, who teach that the rapture of the Church occurs before the 7 years of tribulation, use this verse to verify that theory. There are differing opinions as to when the believers are caught up to meet Jesus in the air. There are several verses in the Book of Revelations that show Christians are still alive during the tribulation period, and according to the bible, Jesus will harvest (rapture) the saints (Revelation 14:14-15) just before the wrath of God is poured out (Revelation 16). For a complete explanation of the end times, see our web page “New Revelations”. In any case, all Christians are “not appointed us to wrath” as it says, as God’s wrath towards us was placed upon Jesus – Thank you Jesus!

This verse tells us that all Christians, dead and alive and who are in the book of life, will get to be with Jesus in eternity. The bible says that the Church will be gathered up to meet Jesus in the air, prior to the wrath of God being poured out. I believe that the presence of the Church and the Holy Spirit is what is keeping the Dragon (Anti-Christ) at bay (2 Thessalonians 2:6-8), and he will become active when the Holy Ghost is taken up from the earth. It really doesn’t matter, one way or the other, as the fact is that we will be with the Lord forever when Jesus comes again – Praise God!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
